title: AI-Based Signal Detection System for Residential TV Dish Alignment
summary: MUST proposes training an AI model on dish-misalignment patterns to improve realignment. Its current design uses stored angles and feedback controls; AI-related gains remain unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: MUST describes a satellite-dish prototype based on stored service-provider angles, motor controls and signal feedback. Those functions are ordinary automation. The source separately proposes training an AI model on misalignment patterns to support faster realignment. This entry covers that intended AI contribution. Model deployment and resulting gains in reliability, adjustment time or maintenance effort are not established. Multi-provider operation and hardware savings are not treated as AI results merely because they are part of the same design.
purpose: Use a trained misalignment model to improve automatic satellite-dish realignment.
system: Proposed AI misalignment model for residential satellite dishes
developer: Mbeya University of Science and Technology (MUST)

ratings.reason: The proposed trained model is intended to improve dish realignment and reduce household inconvenience. The chapter reports no benefit from an implemented AI model.
Faster AI-assisted realignment is intended to reduce servicing effort. Savings from the proposed learned model are not established.

ai_role.statement: A learned misalignment model is proposed as future work. The currently specified stored-angle lookup, motor movement and feedback controls do not by themselves establish AI use.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 8: AI-Based Signal Detection System for Residential TV Dish Alignment

produced_by: Proposed training of an AI model on dish-misalignment patterns
must_hold: Representative labeled misalignment and signal-quality data

headline: Proposed AI model for satellite-dish realignment
